job.question: Which retirement plan's investment consulting RFP requires that, as of December 31, 2024, the firm have at least three public fund clients each with at least $1B in assets and have been in business at least ten years?
job.expected_facts: The Retirement Plan for CTA Employees (Chicago Transit Authority), in its April 29, 2025 investment consulting RFP.
job.acceptance: Retirement Plan for CTA/Chicago Transit Authority Employees; publication date is optional.

reviews.reason: This is a 2020 Texas Municipal Retirement System RFP for global custody services, not an investment consulting RFP for the Retirement Plan for CTA Employees. It does not state the specified eligibility requirements as of December 31, 2024.
quotes: Request for Proposal Global Custody and Related Services Texas Municipal Retirement System (TMRS) Issue Date: December 11, 2020

The primary purpose of this RFP is to identify the most qualified firm to provide global custodial services, recordkeeping / accounting services, performance measurement / analytics, support for an unbundled securities lending program and other services to TMRS as defined in this RFP.
